notes.title: Game status August 21, 2025
notes.content: [p]Good day! We tell you the current state of affairs of the project...[/p][p][/p][p][b]Changes in the game:[/b][/p][list][*][p]changed the design bureau room (improved graphics, optimization and work with light)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]improved the usability of the interface, pop-up tips and reminders, new icons[/p][/*][*][p]added support for new resolutions and brightness-gamma settings[/p][/*][*][p]changed the order of saving progress in the game[/p][/*][*][p]added 2 new race tracks[/p][/*][*][p]reworked the testing ground for the player's cars in terms of graphics[/p][/*][*][p]added Steam achievements[/p][/*][*][p]combined the global map with the local one, now it is one level (this solution saves you from waiting for loading and adds dynamics to the gameplay)[/p][/*][*][p]added 2 new car models for the computer[/p][/*][/list][p][b]What else is planned to be done before the release and what progress:[/b][/p][list][*][p]improve the graphics of individual rooms in the game (50%)[/p][/*][*][p]diversify the game location and the player's base with new buildings (60%)[/p][/*][*][p]improve the textures of surfaces, make soft transitions between surfaces (20%)[/p][/*][*][p]improve car control and make it more diverse (60%)[/p][/*][*][p]introduce visual customization for the starting car model (80%)[/p][/*][*][p]add the ability to set records on the track and beat them (70%)[/p][/*][*][p]improve the behavior of bots on the road during races (60%)[/p][/*][*][p]add interactive training (80%)[/p][/*][/list][p]We wanted to do all this after the release, which was planned for this month. But after conducting closed tests, we decided that it would be better for the project to make a number of improvements and release the game in the fall of 2025. Being a small team of developers, we cannot take risks at the start of the game. In the event of a negative reaction from players at the start, our project may perish from bad reviews and never get into the freely recommended products of Steam.[/p][p]In this regard, we will polish and improve the product further, so that at the start it is the most positive experience for players! Let us remind you that our dream is to create a large simulator of production of not only cars, but also other transport in one game, with the ability to manage both production and the transport itself. We want to gradually develop all aspects of the game so that within a few years it will double in content, graphics and gaming capabilities. But we can't do it without you! Thank you for your understanding and patience![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45476935/824222d2de2a998df7208d3ba962da16f1eda830.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Game status as of June 17, 2025
notes.content: [p][b]Good day![/b][/p][list][*][p]We inform you that the game recently passed closed beta testing, as a result of which a number of errors and bugs were identified and are now being fixed.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Also, over the past month, we have fixed errors in the interface, added "fog of war" on the global map. We have introduced a new model of behavior of computer opponents in the strategic mode, now your opponents more aggressively capture and improve production facilities on the map, including cities.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]We have also created and introduced a new racing location - a night field. The release of this track was planned after the release, but we managed to include it in the early build! And by the time the game is released, this location will already be there![/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Due to the appearance of the night environment, we have carried out additional work with lighting and headlights at night. We had to create a set of measures that allow the effective use of headlights at night.[/p][/*][/list][p]There is very little time left before the release, we are working almost without interruption to make the game in the most pleasant condition for the players by the release![/p][p][/p][p][b]In important news, we also wanted to inform you that we have started creating a Chinese localization so that users from China can play and read information and use the entire interface in their native language![/b][/p]

notes.title: Game release date
notes.content: [p][b]Good day! [/b] We are happy to inform you that we have completed the regulation of legal issues that we wrote about earlier and now there is nothing standing in the way of the game's release! The game will be released on July 16, 2025 after a series of formal checks by Steam. During the remaining month, we will focus our efforts on finding critical errors in the gameplay, and we also plan to complete a training module that will help you understand the game faster.[/p][p][/p][p][i]We also present to your attention the roadmap for the development of the project:[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]July-August 2025: [/b] Making adjustments received after feedback from players[/p][p][/p][p][b]August-September 2025:[/b] Implementation of two new race tracks[/p][p][/p][p][b]Fall 2025: [/b] Graphics and interface refinement[/p][p][/p][p][b]December 2025: [/b] Global improvement of AI, introduction of new gameplay elements[/p][p][/p][p][b]Winter 2026: [/b] Implementation of a visual car customization system[/p][p][/p][p][b]Spring 2026:[/b] Addition of a new era (1950-1960) and new car bodies[/p][p][/p][p][b]Summer 2026:[/b] Addition of trucks (via DLC)[/p][p][/p][p][b]Fall 2026:[/b] Adding the ability to customize the base and freely build[/p][p][/p][p][b]Winter 2027:[/b] Adding localization and other languages, exiting early access[/p][p][/p][p]We also allow the possibility of accelerating the implementation of this plan with a good financial return (will allow us to attract specialists to implement all our ideas)[/p][p][/p][p]Finally, we want to say that we are a team of enthusiasts and the main goal is to release a really good and interesting game with economic, design and racing elements.[/p][p][/p][p]This will be a dream project that we will bring to completion) But we can't do it without your help![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you all for your attention and your advice, together we will bring the project to its logical conclusion![/p]

notes.title: Project status as of 05/08/2025
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone! [/b]
We guarantee to inform you about the progress of the product development!

Over the last month, we have optimized the control of the electrical appliance, added the ability to control some processes using the keyboard, and we have also worked well with the user interface for managing virtual cards.

We have introduced a new indicator that affects the sale of cars - the volume of sold (the more cars you have sold and the more often they are found on the roads, the easier it is to promote and sell such models)

For racing, the collision and collision system has been improved (previously, when cars made contact, they ricocheted heavily)

We are currently working on improving the visual part of global maps and the control mode, and we are also continuing to work on improving the AI ​​of racing conflicts.

Remember about the promised trailer and record it soon with the new AI.

The delays in the game's release are due to legal difficulties for us as developers from Russia (the country is under sanctions, so we have to look for workarounds to release quality products to the market). However, we are on the way to solving them! In a positive outcome, we expect the game to be released in [b]early-mid June 2025[/b]. As soon as the situation becomes clearer, we will immediately set an exact release date! Thank you all for your attention!

notes.title: Current game status
notes.content:
[b]Good day![/b] We would like to inform everyone who is following the project that we have now completely completed work on the graphics, logic and sound in the game. We are currently working on the user interface and creating training.

According to our rough estimates, this process will take about a month. We would also like to inform you that over the past month the project has been further improved, namely: textures and logic processes have been optimized, due to which the load on your software will decrease) We have also implemented an achievement system.

We are planning to release a trailer soon demonstrating the current capabilities of the game. [b] Thanks to everyone who is following the project and helping its development, your attention is very important to us![/b]
